method: Independent parsing of delivered GLB float32 channels, shortest-path quaternion slerp and canonical FK at 120Hz. No authoring functions or IK. Support diameter of sole center, toe and heel with external reference trajectory applied exactly once. Native Root stays identity. Raw v9 and v10 pose/velocity deltas are both retained; v10 nominated native boundaries are acceptance gates. Browser evidence separately audits displayed blending to v9/v10.

jump.definition: Both delivered sole center/toe/heel minima exceed 2 cm; consecutive 120 Hz samples. Gravity estimate is descriptive because a bent-leg pose shifts sole height independently of the center of mass.
